notes.forwarded_1233_vs_expected_1271: Raw grep counts 1273 'class="forwarded body"' divs across all sources (264/171/816/20/2 per chat, grep-verified). The other 40 blocks (27 private_group, 11 public_group, 2 accounting_group) sit inside message divs with class 'joined' and contain NO from_name, because Telegram Desktop's export renderer merges the origin label onto the first block of a run of consecutive forwards from the same source. Proven by lxml probe over all 19 files: joined-without-name=40, not-joined-without-name=0 in every chat. This is the anticipated joined-forward merge, not a parser miss; the 1271 exploration figure corresponds to the raw block count (1273), not to blocks carrying a label.
